Bounded conditional motifs can require exact declared features:two humps,bird peak stain,white crescent location,adhered grounds,or line plus three terminal dots
Record ambiguous identification and alternatives;source three-period example retains days/months/years without choosing or scheduling an outcome

feasibility.reuse: Only narrowly compatible pure text/JSON/hash/report patterns and,if justified,explicit manual observation validation. feasibility.seeded: Optional future synthetic icon/residue representation requires a new named distribution/protocol and independent vectors. It is not physical grounds and does not improve forecast accuracy. Manual mode is sufficient for first scope.
feasibility.privacy: All context optional and local;no identity,health,birth data,third-party biography,photo or remote service required. Public author claims about knowing names or spirits do not authorize inference or contact claims.
feasibility.limitations: No actual fortune,medical/personality conclusion,hidden personal-history retrieval,deceased contact or validated supernatural capability. Cultural heritage recognition and author anecdotes are not predictive validation.
